full_prompt_en: A square oil painting in a dark Renaissance manner shows a gathering of bearded men around a seated figure in a rose-colored satin robe. The background is a shadowy interior of brown stone and charcoal darkness, with a narrow column of pale light falling from above near the center. The seated man occupies the lower middle and turns his face upward toward a dark-haired man leaning in from the right. His broad robe pools across the floor in heavy mauve and dusty pink folds, each crease catching a thin silvery highlight. A pale patterned collar frames his neck. One hand rests near a small round metal object at his lap, while the other hangs over his bent knee toward another polished vessel near the floor. At far right, the leaning man wears dark gleaming armor over black clothing; his metal sleeve forms a hard diagonal toward the central figure. Behind them, an older man with white beard and dark green robe bends over pale folded pages, and another older face watches from the deeper shade. At left, two more bearded men in brown and dark green garments lean inward, their heads staggered at different heights. All attention converges on the seated figure and the papers between the group. The floor is a muted stone plane carrying the weight of the rose fabric and several round, bronzed vessels. Warm browns, oxblood mauve, tarnished gold, and deep green fill most of the scene. The paint models faces and hands with warm flesh tones, while the robe and armor have bright, tactile glints. Light comes from high above the central grouping, leaving the corners and rear wall dark. The arrangement forms a compact arc of heads and gestures around the luminous seated figure, giving the scene theatrical intimacy and dense material depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、深暗文艺复兴式油画描绘一群蓄须男子围在一名穿玫瑰色缎袍的坐者旁。背景是棕色石质与炭黑阴影构成的昏暗室内，一束窄浅光从上方落在中央附近。坐者占据下方中部，仰脸看向从右侧俯身靠近的黑发男子。他宽大的袍子在地面堆成厚重的灰紫与蒙尘粉色褶皱，每道折痕都接到细银光。浅色花纹衣领框住脖颈。一只手靠在腿边的小圆金属物旁，另一只手垂过弯起的膝头，指向地面的另一件光亮器皿。最右侧俯身者在黑衣外穿着暗而发亮的甲胄，金属袖形成指向中央人物的硬斜线。他们后方，一位白须老人穿深绿袍，俯向几张浅色折页；另一张年长面孔从更深的阴影里观看。左侧还有两名穿棕色与深绿衣服的蓄须男子向内倾身，头部错落在不同高度。所有注意力汇聚到坐者及众人之间的纸页上。地面是低调的石质平面，承托玫瑰色布料及几件圆形铜金色器物。暖棕、暗红灰紫、失光金色与深绿填满大部分场景。颜料用暖肤色塑出脸和手，袍子与甲胄则有明亮可触的闪光。光从中央人群上方来，让角落和后墙保持深暗。各头部与姿势围绕受光坐者组成紧凑弧形，赋予画面戏剧性的亲密感与浓密的材料纵深。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting models forms with warm layered glazes and decisive light emerging from a deep brown ground. Broad dark masses enclose a compact luminous center; softly graded midtones establish volume while reflective passages are punctuated by narrow sharp glints. Curving folded planes carry broken highlights that follow their weight, contrasting with firmer diagonal edges elsewhere. Oxblood mauve, muted green, umber, and tarnished gold interlock rather than appearing as flat blocks. Background detail thins quickly into shadow, while overlapping shapes and directional lines establish compressed depth. A high directional glow draws the eye through the central cluster, and dense brush texture keeps the dramatic arrangement grounded in tangible surfaces.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画以暖色层层罩染塑造形体，让明确光线从深棕底色中浮现。宽阔暗色块围合紧凑亮中心；柔和渐层的中间调建立体积，反光区域则被细窄锐利亮点打断。弯曲折叠的平面上，断续高光顺着重量走，与别处更坚决的斜边形成对照。暗红灰紫、低调绿、赭棕和失光金色相互咬合，而非平贴成块。背景细节迅速隐入阴影，交叠形态与定向线条建立压缩的纵深。高处定向光引导视线穿过中心聚合处，浓密笔触肌理则让戏剧性排列依附于可触表面。
theme_en: Bearded men gather around a seated man in rose-colored robes
theme_zh: 蓄须男子们围在一名身穿玫瑰色长袍的坐者周围
name: Tintoretto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
